title: Decision: SetErrorType::Display static match instead of serde roundtrip
description: The static match in Display for SetErrorType is correct and intentional. The serde roundtrip was clever but allocated a Value, could panic on serde failure (returning 'unknown'), and depended on serde's rename_all behavior being stable. The static match is O(1), allocation-free, and exhaustive-checked at compile time (within the crate). A future maintainer might suggest 'going back to the DRY serde approach' — resist this. The match must stay in sync with serde rename_all, but that's verifiable by inspection; the roundtrip had an invisible runtime dependency.
